The PR changes only documentation: it replaces the v0.10.6 candidate heading with a v0.10.7 candidate and adds about 400 lines of release notes (head 11-413). No executable source, configuration or workflow files appear in this batch, and the head-side text is not supplied. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not verify the added notes beyond the first lines.

The examined base text describes security-relevant behavior that already existed, including the SSD prefix cache (T-041), App Attest worker and endpoint resumption (TB-011, T-053), release registration, staging and dev lanes, relaxed installer signature checks for pre-release versions, and env-var rollbacks. I found no evidence of a control regression introduced by these changes. The visible head hunk only mentions pair-update and tensor-parallel rollout notes (cluster/pairing), which are outside the supplied threat-model assets in this view.

A changelog edit does not change runtime security controls. Remaining integration questions: the rest of the head changelog may describe code changes in other batches (cluster pairing wire, Qwen tensor-parallel control wire, coordinated pair updates). Those need review in their own source units, particularly for authentication of the inter-Mac cluster channel and update coordination, which are not covered by the supplied threat definitions. I cannot clear them from this documentation-only batch.
